notes: Closed named OSM raceway retained as a course candidate. Named-layout association requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.

Produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union, EU-DEM layers.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 71 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Sparse paired road-limit observations reviewed on nine cross-section image sheets and enlarged junction details from the pinned licensed image. Road-color positions are only authoring candidates; dark patches, paint and curb interruptions are corrected against visible edges. The northern branch openings on the fitted straight and the open branch at source stations 429 through 438 uses an estimated virtual join along the main route, not the full branch apron. Source direction, starting point and coordinates are retained independently from the reversed sibling. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. Curbs remain illustrative, banking unknown and raster elevations estimated. The straight sections (stations 24–264, 312–420, 486–519 and 615–639) use separate visible endpoint fits for the two road edges; their intermediate controls are cross-section intersections with those observed edge lines, not independent pixel measurements or nominal widths.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
